messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: lavaan 0.5-18 released on CRAN
parts:
This is rather big update, with many changes under the hood. For a full
overview of new features and bug fixes, see
http://lavaan.ugent.be/history/dot5.html

If you are using equality constraints, please read this document carefully:

lavaan.ugent.be/notes/lavaan_eq_constraints.pdf

as it may impact the interpretation of eg the output of coef(), vcov(),
modindices(), etc...

In a way, 0.5-18 is a transition version to give external packages the
time to adapt. Once these packages are again in sync with the new
changes, another version (0.5-19) will be released where the changes are
fully implemented.

Yves.
